<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;1,400&family=Source+Code+Pro:wght@400;600&display=swap');

  /* Kill Quarto's auto-generated title block on cover page */
  #title-block-header { display: none !important; }

  /* Scoped reset. Do NOT use * {} or it kills Quarto's navbar */
  .banner, .banner * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  .banner {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 60px);
    position: relative;
    background: #f7f4ee;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  /* ── Left column ── */
  .left-col {
    flex: 0 0 420px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 64px 48px 84px 64px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .left-col::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 5px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1a3a5c 0%, #8a5a2b 55%, #c8922a 100%);
  }

  .eyebrow {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8a5a2b;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .banner-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 52px;
    line-height: 1.08;
    color: #1a2535;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .banner-title em {
    color: #c8922a;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  .banner-subtitle {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 18px;
    color: #5a7a9a;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .divider {
    width: 48px;
    height: 2px;
    background: #c8922a;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }
  .tag {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #1a3a5c;
    border: 1px solid #d8c8a8;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: #fbf3e2;
  }

  .enter-button {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    align-self: flex-start;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #f7f4ee;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: #1a3a5c;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .enter-button:hover { background: #2a5a8c; color: #f7f4ee; }

  .status {
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #8a9aaa;
    margin-top: 28px;
    max-width: 300px;
  }

  .credit {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 28px; left: 64px;
    font-size: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: #8a9aaa;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* ── Right column ── */
  .right-col {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-left: 1px solid #dde5ee;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 40px 44px;
  }

  .art-svg {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 640px;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  @media (max-width: 860px) {
    .banner { flex-direction: column; }
    .left-col { flex: none; padding: 48px 32px 72px 32px; }
    .credit { left: 32px; }
    .right-col { padding: 32px 20px 32px 32px; }
    .banner-title { font-size: 38px; }
  }
</style>
